"# Real-Time Notifications Feature Implementation Plan

This plan outlines the architecture for sending and receiving notifications in real-time, fulfilling your request for a dynamic admin-to-student notification system.

## Proposed Changes

### 1. Notification Data Model & Routes
The existing `Notification` model will be utilized.
- **New API Routes (`routes/apiRoutes.js` or similar)**:
  - `GET /api/notifications`: Retrieves unread notifications for the currently logged-in student.
  - `POST /api/notifications/clear`: Marks all unread notifications as "read" for the current student.

### 2. Admin Side (Sending Notifications)
- **New UI (`views/admin/notifications.ejs`)**: A new page in the Admin Dashboard where the admin can compose and broadcast notifications to all students (or specific groups).
- **Backend Handler (`controllers/adminController.js`)**: 
  - Save the new notifications in the database.
  - Automatically emit a Socket.io event (`new-notification`) so online students receive it instantly without refreshing.
- **Sidebar Integration**: Add a "Send Notification" link to the admin sidebar in `header.ejs`.

### 3. Student Side (Receiving & Clearing)
- **Header Updates (`views/partials/header.ejs`)**:
  - Replace the hardcoded notifications in the bell icon dropdown with a dynamically populated list.
  - Add the **Clear All** button inside the dropdown header.
  - Add a dynamic badge counter on the bell icon.
- **Client-Side JavaScript**:
  - Fetch initial unread notifications on page load via the new `GET /api/notifications` route.
  - Listen for the `new-notification` Socket.io event to append new alerts and bump the badge count in real-time.
  - Wire up the "Clear All" button to send an asynchronous POST request, wiping the notifications list and hiding the badge immediately without a page refresh.
